legacy_examples.label: Live TV account
legacy_examples.reason: Native adds its own Xtream, Stalker, M3U/XMLTV accounts and EPG/player controls. The official discovery hub exposes addons, media servers and plugins, not this IPTV account/guide stack. Addon live streams are not equivalent IPTV configuration controls.

legacy_examples.label: Switch add-on on failure
legacy_examples.reason: Native adds ordered cross-provider/addon failure retries and per-provider attempt limits through fontefalha. Official preferred resolver/provider and stream preferences do not expose this independent retry policy. No resolver behaviour is changed here.

legacy_examples.label: Subtitle font
legacy_examples.reason: Native has independent styling, placement, timing and reset for a simultaneously rendered second subtitle. Official secondaryPreferredLanguage feeds ordered track selection with one shared subtitle style, not a second independently styled overlay. Primary subtitle styling remains unbadged.

legacy_examples.label: Delay
legacy_examples.reason: Native has independent styling, placement, timing and reset for a simultaneously rendered second subtitle. Official secondaryPreferredLanguage feeds ordered track selection with one shared subtitle style, not a second independently styled overlay. Primary subtitle styling remains unbadged.

legacy_examples.label: AllDebrid key
legacy_examples.reason: Native adds AllDebrid credentials and explicit validation. Official connected-service credentials support Real-Debrid, TorBox and Premiumize; the shared providers are not badged.

legacy_examples.label: Switch provider on failure
legacy_examples.reason: Native adds ordered cross-provider/addon failure retries and per-provider attempt limits through fontefalha. Official preferred resolver/provider and stream preferences do not expose this independent retry policy. No resolver behaviour is changed here.
